name: Scantron sprint
summary: A two-minute memory game on a drawn bubble sheet: peek and the answer key fills in pencil for a few seconds then erases, fill the bubbles from memory and turn it in, and it comes back graded in red pen with your score circled; everyone gets the same key, so the chat's scores line up on the side like returned tests.
useWhen: need a 2 min study break game
bet i can beat ur memory
something dumb to play between study sessions
quick game for the group chat during finals
who has the best memory in here
dontUseWhen: actually quizzing course material (use exam-quiz or flashcard-relay)

sheet.description: Printed at the top of the sheet, e.g. 'PSYCH 110 · practice midterm'

round.description: Round name; a new round makes a new answer key

said.description: What they said about it, in their words
